core_obligations: Set R = U x_X U and R' = U x_Y U; the morphism R -> R' is a monomorphism.
Decent: the fibres of |U| -> |X| and |R| -> |X| over x inject into the fibres of |U| -> |Y| and |R'| -> |Y| over f(x), which are finite by decency of Y.
Reasonable: universally bounded fibres of U -> Y bound the fibres of U -> X, since a fibre over x is a subset of the fibre over f(x) with the same degrees.
proof_roadmap: Monomorphism relation of the two groupoids; fibre injection for decent; subset bound for reasonable.
difficulty_reason: A two-case transfer; the injections and the subset bound are short but real.
